_meta.description: Closed set of currencies accepted by Money, PriceEntry and CostSummary in tracer-evalschema 0.0.1. Every code must also exist in iso4217_active.json. The set is defined by ADR 0014 Decision 2; adding a code is a breaking change (it also reshapes CostSummary), per ADR 0014 Decision 5.

sources.note: Decision 2 defines SupportedCurrency as a closed, data-driven list (file shape and USD-only set); Decision 5 classifies adding a currency as breaking.

_meta.verification: Authored from the ADR 0014 text (Decisions 2 and 5, revision 7) and the project owner decision of 2026-10-22; not downloaded from an external source. The only check performed is that the code USD exists in iso4217_active.json. No other check was made: this file does not verify the owner decision itself, and it does not check that USD is the right set for any deployment.
